# State-Weighted Nonlinear Frontier Run

## Objective

Replace the lossy scalar worst-history target by a typed boundary-state
transfer calculus, then determine whether the existing finite `SU(2)` block
has a genuine overlap between typical Gaussian fields and certified nonlinear
geometry.

## Non-negotiable preservation constraints

- exact lattice gauge covariance;
- positivity of the regulated measure;
- locality or a declared summable quasilocal error;
- inclusion of all positive-mass histories and chart complements;
- explicit volume, cutoff, heat-time, block-size, and boundary quantifiers;
- separation of finite regulated results from RG, continuum, OS, and spectral
  claims.

## Targets

### Stage 19 -- state-weighted defect transfer

- [x] Define a bad-transition subkernel on retained boundary states.
- [x] Prove telescoping weighted chain bounds.
- [x] Prove rooted connected-set summability.
- [x] Recover scalar adaptive domination at weight `V=1`.
- [x] Exhibit a process with scalar conditional ceiling one but small weighted
  growth rate.
- [x] Identify the finite-state Perron--Frobenius optimization.
- [x] Mechanize threshold arithmetic and hostile examples.

### Stage 20 -- finite `SU(2)` boundary-state disintegration

- [x] Define relative tree gauge on a finite graph with boundary.
- [x] Prove uniqueness and invariance under interior gauge transformations.
- [x] Prove covariance under boundary gauge transformations.
- [x] Split normalized quotient edges into retained state and interior fiber.
- [x] state the exact Haar disintegration and conditional kernel.
- [x] Verify a reflection-compatible `2x2` plaquette block.
- [x] Show that omitting a crossing boundary edge loses conditional
  sufficiency.
- [x] Derive center, cut-locus, and orbit labels from the complete retained
  holonomies rather than treating them as untracked metadata.

### Stage 21 -- dependency-aware local typical-set atlas

- [x] Prove a Gaussian block-union bound without independence.
- [x] Construct the Coulomb physical covariance of the `2^4` block.
- [x] Compute link, four-link plaquette-input, and curvature leverage bounds.
- [x] Replace the global `408`-ball diagnostic by local radii.
- [x] Freeze the radius required at the degree-18 threshold.
- [x] Compare it with the existing nonlinear certificate.

### Stage 22 -- nonlinear overlap audit

- [x] Separate heat-kernel radial curvature, plaquette-map nonlinearity, and
  incidence aggregation.
- [x] compute the exact current-certificate feasibility frontier.
- [x] certify the smallest typical radius from Stage 21.
- [x] test whether the current majorant closes at that radius.
- [x] quantify the exact remaining radius and margin deficits.
- [x] formulate a sharp operator-Hessian replacement target.
- [x] impose a decision gate: proceed to weighted multi-link charging only if
  a nonempty overlap window is proved.

## Claim discipline

Completion of a todo means that the theorem, counterexample, calibration, or
failure certificate was produced. It does not mean that an open Yang--Mills
inequality was silently assumed. The run remains finite and regulator-level.
